newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firm on government securities demand.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firm on government securities demand.

text.p: The rouble firmed in active trading on Thursday on client demand and demand for government securities and dealers said the central bank had been selling roubles to soften the shortage.

The central bank was selling roubles for today settlement at 5,734-36 per dollar, dealers said and added the volume of intervention might be around $100 million. Central bank officials were unavailable for comment.
roubles/dollar Apr 10 midday Apr 10 early Apr 9 close

"T-bill prices eased last week and their yields became attractive for local banks and non-residents. It is a standard situation when roubles are going to that market," Inkombank dealer Dzhamil Asfari said.
Another dealer said the rouble was higher on aggressive buying by a major bank, demand from bank clients outside Moscow, and payments for two trillion roubles of OGSZ savings bonds on April 4.
